title: mail memory: Mailbox/set accepts parentId naming no Mailbox (owner path)
description: RFC 8621 §2.5: parentId must name an existing Mailbox. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory/mod.rs mailbox_failures checks name/role uniqueness and parent loops but not that parentId exists in the final state; only the sharee path (memory/sharing.rs) checks it. Found by the JMAP-cuim agent with an atomic Mailbox/set create in toy-multi-server. Fix: in mailbox_failures, a parentId not in 'after' is invalidProperties [parentId] (checked at commit so a same-request parent creation still works).
